svg.title: Gluten-free evidence engine, overview and zoom
svg.desc: A seven-step spine across the top; below each step a bracketed panel lists everything inside it.
svg.text: Gluten-free evidence engine: seven steps, then the detail
Read the top row first: one arrow per step. Each bracket opens that step into its parts. Nothing inside a panel connects sideways, so there are no crossing lines.
EVALUATION LOOP: HOW THE THRESHOLDS ARE CHOSEN
